title: Compensation and expenses.
bodyText: Each trustee shall serve without compensation but shall be reimbursed by the plan for any necessary expense incurred in the performance of the trustee's duties pertaining to the plan.
bodyHtml: [§88F-4]  Compensation and expenses.  Each trustee shall serve without compensation but shall be reimbursed by the plan for any necessary expense incurred in the performance of the trustee's duties pertaining to the plan. [L 1996, c 212, pt of §2]
